purpose: Host-level production deployment contract for BRO. Host deployment, health readback, or intelligent acceptance evidence do not by themselves satisfy final production graduation.

HOST_DEPLOYED: exact current-main source revision installed from git archive
durable SQLite/WAL state writable by dedicated bro service user
fresh heartbeat read back from durable state for the exact deployed revision
PRODUCTION_ACCEPTED: repository contract gates green for the deployed revision
real external-system acceptance evidence bound to the deployed revision
INTELLIGENT_ACCEPTED: natural-language request interpreted through a declared provider-neutral non-test external model boundary
model boundary receives only bounded task context and never effect-provider credentials
material interpreted scope shown to and explicitly confirmed by a human before execution

forbids: claiming host heartbeat as external-system evidence
claiming systemd active state as final production graduation
claiming model test fixtures as intelligent production evidence
sending effect-provider credentials or repository source code to the interpretation model
claiming intelligent acceptance alone as final production graduation
deploying a revision that is not current origin/main
embedding secrets in release artifacts or deployment evidence
